snippet.title: The Rolling Scopes
snippet.description:
The Rolling Scopes is not just another community of developers, this is something more.

For years we have been organizing meetups and conferences, where you can always learn something new, share your knowledge, discover new technologies, meet old and find new friends.

The Rolling Scopes was organized in 2013 and now a lot of developers around the world know about us from different kinds of activities: meetups, JS DEV Day, RS Summer Summit, The Rolling Scopes Conferences and RS School.
